name: ELASTIC_ST_ITEM
meaning: lying in the world as an item; msg 2 → CTX_PICKUP (4)

name: ELASTIC_ST_HELD
meaning: attached to the Wolf (msg 4) or placed (msg 5); msg 0x17 → 9 near a tree, then msg 0x15 ties it

name: ELASTIC_ST_TIED_ONE
meaning: one end on tree1 and Ralph holds the other (bungee); msg 0x1a limits and pulls his moves

name: ELASTIC_ST_STRUNG
meaning: tied between two trees (slingshot); walking through catches it, jumping or holding launches

name: ELASTIC_ST_PULLED
meaning: Ralph is holding the band centre (Wolf states 0x72/0x73)

name: ELASTIC_ST_SNAP
meaning: released: vibration plus flight of the launched object

name: ELASTIC_ST_SNAP_END
meaning: cleanup: unfreeze and release the camera, re-register the rider, → 4

name: ELASTIC_ST_STRUNG_IDLE
meaning: strung band shown straight between the trees after Wolf msg 0x6a (death or restart); left only via Reset → 7
